context: Bootstrap a fresh snapshot from three documents

checklist.name: Prerequisite guard
checklist.description: Checks that the in-folder exists and that the ctx folder does not, before writing anything

checklist.name: Scans first
checklist.description: Runs the bundled scanner or an equivalent glob over the in-folder before classifying

checklist.name: Priorities from the user
checklist.description: Asks the user for HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW per file rather than inventing priorities

checklist.name: Sizing applied
checklist.description: Treats the 1200-token design document as inline and the 3200-token CSV as summarised, using words divided by 0.75

checklist.name: Manifest after sizing
checklist.description: Writes manifest.yaml after sizing, with sources.high, sources.medium and sources.low all present and action values set

checklist.name: Manifest validated
checklist.description: Runs validate-manifest.sh on the manifest and reports the result

checklist.name: Baseline within budget
checklist.description: Writes a baseline of at most 2000 tokens that inlines the design document and references the others

checklist.name: Report and handoff
checklist.description: Reports file counts, prints the RISEN INPUT table and suggests /save-context baseline
